geography_qualification.principle: Legal lineage can prevent false identity joins, but legal creation dates alone do not prove that every annual source row is already comparable to a current-boundary geometry.
geography_qualification.post_split_rule: Rows after a split may be legally lineage-eligible for current-entity identity once the successor existed for the full year, but M43 does not assert geometry-equivalent current boundaries or completeness of absent rows.
geography_qualification.unaffected_entity_rule: Absence of a listed creation/split event is not proof that boundary geometry was unchanged; do not upgrade current-boundary comparability without an explicit geometry/legal audit.
geography_qualification.missingness_rule: M41/M42 missingness semantics remain unchanged: absent source rows and the 2001 empty workbook are never zeros.

next_gate.title: BNPB overlap-year semantic reconciliation
tasks: Compare 2010-2017 overlapping official Satu Data resources against the M42 archive at every dimension that can be made genuinely like-for-like.
Test whether archive Menderita is value-compatible with current Terdampak before any rename.
Test the arithmetic relationship, if any, between historical Umum and the three specific facility fields.
Quantify revisions or disagreements for shared victim and physical-impact concepts rather than assuming equality.
Promote only metric-year-geography slices whose semantic and temporal-geography gates both pass.
